# incusos_system_storage (Resource)

Manages IncusOS host storage maintenance schedules (`scrub_schedule`, `trim_schedule`) at `/1.0/system/storage`. To manage individual ZFS pools or volumes, use `incusos_system_storage_pool` and `incusos_system_storage_volume`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `scrub_schedule` (String) Cron expression for scheduled ZFS pool scrubs.
- `trim_schedule` (String) Cron expression for scheduled ZFS pool trims.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
